title: FiduciaCounters
description: Distributed counter payloads: a replicated signed integer per key with a monotonic revision for compare-and-set. Used for success/failure thresholds, quota tallies, and barrier fan-in counts.

CounterAddRequest.title: CounterAddRequest
CounterAddRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/counters/add. Atomically adds delta (which may be negative), creating the counter at 0 first.

key.description: Slash-safe counter key, such as rollout/v2.4.1/failures.

delta.description: Signed amount to add; negative decrements.

prev_revision.description: When set, the add applies only if the counter's current mod_revision matches (compare-and-set).

CounterSetRequest.title: CounterSetRequest
CounterSetRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/counters/set. Writes an absolute value, such as resetting to 0.

prev_revision.description: When set, the set applies only if the current mod_revision matches (compare-and-set).

CounterEntry.title: CounterEntry
CounterEntry.description: The current state of a counter, returned by GET /v1/counters. An absent counter reads as not found and should be treated as 0.

mod_revision.description: Monotonic revision stamped on the last mutation; pass it as prev_revision to compare-and-set.
